summary: Describes Tetrys, an experimental on-the-fly network coding protocol for delay-sensitive and loss-sensitive data over lossy networks. It can recover from lost packets with coded packets without waiting a round trip. It is a product of the Coding for Efficient NetWork Communications Research Group.

eli5.summary: Extra puzzle pieces are sent along with the real ones, so if one gets lost the receiver can rebuild it without asking for a resend.
